text: Numeric share in [0,1] of comments containing emotional aggression (hostile, angry, insulting, contemptuous or belligerent emotional language directed at the OP or others), computed from OC_comments only (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP). Each comment is judged individually and counts if it contains aggression, even alongside logical reasoning; output is aggressive comments divided by total comments, 0 if none. Mere disagreement, firm or critical tone, or generic emotional wording without hostility does not count; quoted text from others is ignored unless the commenter adopts it; OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred are excluded as evidence, while generic delta/platform rules discussion remains eligible. Returns null if the list is missing, malformed, or validly empty (share undefined).
